summary: Iteration 39: Tested admin left sidebar (Administración section), Pagos page + backend, provisioning banner for new clients, OpenAI settings panel (read-only), and the AI web scan (2/day limit, SSRF guard). Everything requested works. Found one regression (not part of this feature): GET /api/admin/monitor/margins returned 500 because _parts() was called with a missing 'pricing' argument, which crashed the Monitor en vivo page with an unhandled-rejection overlay. I fixed it with a one-line change and verified it now returns 200. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed. Frontend: all requested flows passed. Used 2 real LLM scans.

critical.issue: 500 TypeError: _parts() missing 1 required positional argument 'pricing' (monitor.py:269). The signature changed in extra_routes.py but this caller was not updated. FIXED by the testing agent: now passes pricing, returns 200.

minor.issue: SSRF guard only checks the first URL's hostname. httpx runs with follow_redirects=True, so a public URL that redirects (3xx) to 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254 or 10.x is not re-checked. DNS rebinding is also possible because the host is resolved twice. Fix: follow_redirects=False and follow redirects by hand, checking _public() on every hop.

The quota check (count_documents, then insert after the LLM call) is not atomic. Parallel requests from one client can exceed 2/day. Fix: reserve the slot before the LLM call with an atomic counter, and release it if the scan fails.
The 402 detail passes the raw Stripe/proxy text to the user (e.g. 'Invalid response body from API: 404 page not found'). Acceptable, but not user-friendly Spanish.

The admin plan select lists all plans from /admin/plans, but checkout only accepts public plans. Choosing a non-public plan gives 404 'Plan no encontrado'. Filter the select to public plans or allow private plans for admin-sent links.

ui_bugs.issue: api.get('/admin/monitor/margins') has no .catch, so any backend error shows the full-screen 'Unhandled rejection' overlay instead of a toast or inline error.

issues: The accounts table shows every business account (83 in preview, many TEST_ leftovers) with no search or pagination. It will get unwieldy in production.
Remaining scans are only shown after a scan; there is no initial 'te quedan N lecturas hoy' indicator.
The URL input is prefilled from agent.website, which is empty for new clients, even though they gave a website at signup (stored on the user doc).

action_items: Review the testing agent's one-line fix in backend/monitor.py (pass pricing to _parts) and add a regression test for /api/admin/monitor/margins.
Add .catch to the margins fetch in MonitorParts.jsx.
Harden the webscan SSRF guard against redirects and DNS rebinding.
Optional: filter the send-link plan select to public plans; add search or pagination to the Pagos accounts table; show remaining scans up front.
critical_code_review_comments: webscan._fetch: follow_redirects=True skips the private-host check on redirect targets, so SSRF is still possible.
webscan.scan: the quota check is a race (count, then insert after a slow LLM call).
payments.payments(): Stripe is called for both live and test modes on every page load with limit=100 and no pagination; invoices beyond 100 are silently dropped.
PlanGate.AdminTabs is still exported but no longer used (dead code).

rca of the issue: The monitor margins 500 is a regression: extra_routes._parts gained a third 'pricing' parameter but monitor.margins was not updated. Reproduce: as admin open /app/monitor, which calls GET /api/admin/monitor/margins and returns 500 with a TypeError in backend.err.log. Mitigation applied: monitor.py:269 now passes pricing.
